name: What is the typical process for designing and building a luxury wellness bathroom with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for designing and building a luxury wellness bathroom with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for designing and building a luxury wellness bathroom begins with an in-depth consultation to understand your vision and specific needs. We then move into design planning, where our team creates CAD-supported layouts and helps with material selections, ensuring every detail aligns with your spa-inspired goals. Following design approval and permit coordination, our construction phase is managed with clear communication and scheduling transparency. We maintain a single point of coordination throughout, from demolition to final walkthrough, to deliver a cohesive, high-craftsmanship result.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an initial consultation, CAD-supported design planning, permit coordination, and a managed construction phase, all under a single point of coordination to ensure a high-craftsmanship result.
